meta.titulo: The Ledger Notebook — how much did you keep this month?
meta.descricao: Upload the spreadsheet you already use and see in seconds how much came in, how much went out, and what you kept. No sign-up. Everything runs in your browser.

inicio.h1: How much did you keep this month? Show me the spreadsheet and I'll tell you.
inicio.apoio: Upload the spreadsheet you already use and, in seconds, see how much came in, how much went out, and where the money went. No accountant jargon.
inicio.notaMargem2: different column names? no problem, we'll sort it out together.

privacidade.curta: Your spreadsheet never leaves this computer. Everything is calculated right here in the browser and stays right here.
privacidade.rodape: Your numbers stay with you. Everything is calculated right here in your browser and stays there. No number leaves this machine, and I don't have a server to store anything.
privacidade.completa: Your numbers stay with you. Everything is calculated right here in your browser and stays there. No number leaves this machine, and I don't have a server to store anything. If you open it on another device, the notebook will be blank.

dropzone.formatos: CSV or XLSX · up to 5,000 rows
dropzone.podeSoltar: Go ahead, drop it! I'll handle the rest.
dropzone.lendoDetalhe_one: {nome} · {n} row · none of this leaves your computer
dropzone.lendoDetalhe_other: {nome} · {n} rows · none of this leaves your computer

somar.corpo_one: You already have {n} entry saved here. The new spreadsheet has {m}. What should I do with them?
somar.corpo_other: You already have {n} entries saved here. The new spreadsheet has {m}. What should I do with them?
somar.dica: adding may create duplicates if it's the same spreadsheet

mapeamento.titulo: Your spreadsheet uses different names. Help me read it?
mapeamento.apoio: I already guessed what I could. Check each guess and pick the column that's missing. Only date and amount are required. I'll figure out the rest.
mapeamento.faltaCampo: Just one thing left: tell me which column is {campo}.

banner.texto_one: You're browsing a sample notebook: {nome}, {n} month of entries.
banner.texto_other: You're browsing a sample notebook: {nome}, {n} months of entries.

indicadores.margemFrase: For every {cem} that came in, you kept {x}.
indicadores.margemSemEntrada: Nothing came in this month, so there's no margin to calculate.

manchete.positiva: {mes} was good. You kept {valor}, {p}% more than {mesAnterior}.
manchete.neutra: In {mes}, you kept {valor}, {p}% less than {mesAnterior}. Still in the black.
manchete.negativa: {mes} was tight: {valor} more went out than came in. It happens.

insights.resumo_positivo: {mes} was good. You kept {valor}, {percentual}% more than {mesAnterior}.
insights.resumo_negativo: {mes} was tight: {valor} more went out than came in. It happens.
insights.resumo_neutro: In {mes}, you kept {valor}, {percentual}% less than {mesAnterior}. Still in the black.
insights.maior_categoria: Your biggest expense in {mes} was {categoria}: {percentual}% of what went out.
insights.categoria_subindo: Heads up: {categoria} is up {percentual}% compared to your 3-month average.
insights.mes_vermelho_historico: {mes} closed in the red: you fell short by {valor}.
insights.projecao_azul: At this pace, {mes} should end in the black, with about {valor} left over.
insights.projecao_vermelho: At this pace, {mes} could end in the red. Might be worth easing up on spending.

secoes.entrouSaiu: In vs. out, month by month
secoes.aLapis: in pencil, because it's an estimate
secoes.verNumerosTabela: See the numbers in a table

projecao.explicacao: This isn't a forecast of the future: it's what happens if the next few months repeat the average of the last three.
projecao.poucosMeses_one: Based on just {n} month. The more months, the better the guess.
projecao.poucosMeses_other: Based on just {n} months. The more months, the better the guess.
projecao.semDados: It's still too early to guess. Log a few months and I'll work out an estimate.

filtros.zeroResultados: Nothing logged with these filters. There are no {categoria} entries in {mes}. How about looking at the whole year?

lancamento.descricaoPlaceholder: e.g. flour, electric bill, counter sale

erros.valorFaltando: Missing the amount. How much was it?
erros.valorMaiorQueZero: The amount needs to be greater than zero.

exclusao.faixa: Deleted {descricao} ({valor}). The numbers have already been recalculated.

vazios.aindaConhecendo: Still getting to know your business
vazios.paginaEmBrancoApoio: Upload a spreadsheet or log the first entry by hand.

toasts.semCategoria_one: {n} row with no category went to Other.
toasts.semCategoria_other: {n} rows with no category went to Other.
toasts.linhasInvalidas_one: {n} row with no date or amount was left out. The rest came in fine.
toasts.linhasInvalidas_other: {n} rows with no date or amount were left out. The rest came in fine.
toasts.semStorage: This browser isn't letting me save (private tab or full storage). Your entries stay here until you close the tab. Export before you leave.
toasts.dadosCorrompidos: Part of your saved data was damaged. I kept a backup copy and started a fresh notebook.
toasts.erroArquivo: I couldn't read this file. Try a CSV or XLSX.

apagar.corpo_one: I'll delete {n} entry and the categories you created. There's no undo, because I don't keep a copy anywhere.
apagar.corpo_other: I'll delete {n} entries and the categories you created. There's no undo, because I don't keep a copy anywhere.
apagar.dica: tip: export first, just in case.
apagar.mantem: Your theme and language stay as they are.

seusDados.titulo: Your numbers stay with you, and only with you.
seusDados.copiaApoio: Downloads a CSV with every entry, in the same format the notebook reads. Works as a backup and for opening somewhere else.
seusDados.zeroApoio: Deletes entries, the categories you created and filters from this browser. Your theme and language stay as they are.
seusDados.vazio: Your notebook is empty: nothing to take or delete yet.
seusDados.zeradoDetalhe: I erased everything from this browser. Whenever you want, just upload a spreadsheet.

assinatura.texto: handmade by Igor Rodrigues de Matos

graficos.fluxoDescricao: Money in and out from {m1} to {m2}. Every month had something left over, except {mesRuim}, when you fell short by {valorRuim}. {melhorMes} was your best month: {valorMelhor} left over.
graficos.projecaoDescricao: What was left per month from {m1} to {m2}, and an estimate for the next 3 months: around {valor} a month, based on the average of {baseM1} to {baseM3}.
